admission.utc_days: closed, chronological and contiguous from the holdout start
admission.immutable_inputs: each admitted day, index, status and terminal verdict is SHA-256 pinned
admission.crash_recovery: hashed staged state is promoted only after the complete evidence object uploads successfully
admission.runtime_binding: the evaluator loads this file and the protocol by checksum and rejects dependency or caller-supplied identity drift
admission.causal_execution: entry and unwind books cannot be newer than their frozen receipt-clock evaluation times
admission.economics: five-share targets, fixed limits, direct fill levels, VWAP, fee rounding, settlement payout and PnL are independently recomputed
admission.paired_latencies: each globally unique signal and latency row completes the exact 400 and 500 millisecond pair
admission.matched_controls: every base signal has exactly one same-decision direction reversal and one five-second time shift; source signal IDs, counts and execution-row totals are checked bidirectionally
admission.raw_inputs: all 24 raw direct-CLOB hours and the previous-day boundary carry-in must match verified S3 manifests; active metadata is preserved across UTC midnight
admission.evidence_order: day results are validated before persistence or upload; staged state and complete evidence upload successfully before formal forward admission

stopping.primary: resolved full five-share base entries only
stopping.common_cutoff: the earliest decision receipt timestamp satisfying 1000 full base entries at both latencies across at least seven UTC days
stopping.partials: reported in risk, PnL and EV but never advance stopping
stopping.controls: each control needs at least 100 resolved full entries per latency and base net EV must exceed every control
stopping.statistics: positive net EV, positive one-sided 99 percent day-cluster lower bound and Bonferroni-adjusted exact sign p-value at both latencies
